assumptions: all listed device resources are available to this workload
peak rates and bandwidth are sustainable for the workload
operation classes do not add when their execution overlaps
logical payload bytes are normalized as cold HBM traffic; cache hits and the measured campaign's warmed-cache regime are not modeled
strict_global_resource_floor.interpretation: An optimistic cold-HBM whole-device roofline normalization, not a lower bound for the warmed single-workgroup measurements and not a single-workgroup latency prediction.

practical_dispatch_floor.required_measurement: A digest-pinned minimal or empty kernel using the same persistent ROCr queue, signal, kernarg, warmup, block, and timestamp protocol.
practical_dispatch_floor.interpretation: A measured software and device dispatch latency floor; keep distinct from the strict global resource floor.

required_inputs: audited per-kernel gfx950 ISA instruction counts
official or experimentally validated per-CU issue throughput by instruction class
